name: Adaptive Control
description: The course introduces the principles and design of adaptive control systems — controllers that can adjust their parameters in real time to maintain desired performance despite plant uncertainties. Students will develop a rigorous understanding of parameter estimation, model reference adaptive control, and Lyapunov-based design methods, with applications to robotics, aerospace, and automotive systems. Background in Lyapunov theory will be helpful.
